notes.title: The Last Update
notes.notes:
All good things come to an end.
No, I don't mean the game, but my free time.

And with the end of my free time (oh that sounds a bit bad) I also end the tracking and bugfixing of the game.

I fixed a bug and hid a duck. But that has to be enough.

The game is now available for free for everyone. Those who bought it before are welcome to drop by for a beer.

Cheers,
Moo

notes.title: Duck Update
notes.notes:
It's finally here, the long awaited duck update.

An independent market research team consulted at least 3 people and they all agreed: "More ducks won't hurt."

For that reason, the duck content of the game has been increased by more than 30%.

Have fun!
